_note: PROVIDER / AGENT REGISTRY — the single source of truth for who exists, what tier (capability level) they serve, what model family they belong to (for cross-family review), what jobs they may do, and how to detect them. Prose files never name a model tier or family; they point here. Adding an agent = add an entry here (see local-llm-example). Providers at a level are REPLACEABLE: swap the model/backing without touching policy. Invariant policy (bans, gates) lives in AGENTS.md/DOCTRINE.md; everything that changes with the market lives here.

frontier.job: Hard review, architecture, and land-gate judgment

sole.job: Scarce judgment: diff review and MCP interpretation

terra.job: Volume: MCP bulk, implementation, and standing bot work

luna.job: Dispatch only: queue, assign, status, and risk gate

anthropic.label: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.note: Fable and Opus are ONE family — never counts as two for a cross-family gate.

openai.label: OpenAI (GPT / Codex)
openai.note: Sol, Terra, Luna share the Codex pipe.

xai.label: xAI (Grok)
xai.note: Grok Build CLI + the two Grok Bot app identities.

open-weight.label: Open-weight (independent lab)
open-weight.note: The first review family that is none of Anthropic/OpenAI/xAI — the reason Review E earns a seat.

cursor-pool.label: Cursor harness (mixed underlying models)
cursor-pool.note: A harness, not a model family; never a cross-family reviewer.

codex-luna.label: Codex Luna (dispatch)
codex-luna.notes: Default dispatcher. Queue/assign/status/risk-gate only; never implements.

codex-terra.label: Codex GPT Terra (MCP volume)
codex-terra.notes: Google-MCP bulk fetches to output_path. May be promoted off dispatch for a named brief.

codex-sol.label: Codex GPT-5.6 Sol (Review B / MCP judgment)
codex-sol.notes: Scarce OpenAI judgment. Soft cap in usage-windows.json (codex-sol). Not the implementer.

grok-build.label: Grok Build CLI (implement)
grok-build.notes: Default implementer. 1 worktree / 1 branch / named file scope. Not Google-MCP unless a connector is present.

grok-bot-review-d.label: Grok Bot — Website Visual QA (Review D)

detect.note: macOS/iOS + xAI cloud computer; no CLI/API/webhook. Dispatched via Slack #visual-qa.

grok-bot-review-d.notes: Credential-free preview walks only. Never Admin/publish/implement. Input to the pixel gate, not a code reviewer.

grok-bot-heat-map.label: Grok Bot — Heat Map (Clarity analytics)

detect.note: Second Grok Bot identity; separate auth; shares #visual-qa by content-match.

grok-bot-heat-map.notes: Read-only Clarity heatmaps/replays/Summarize. Feeds Dispatch. Never a review verdict, never implements.

fable-5.label: Fable 5 (Review A / architecture)
fable-5.notes: Hard PR/architecture review WHILE a live Claude seat includes Fable. Availability is a subscription grant — see subscriptions.json grants.fable and bin/detect-fable.py. Never the daily coder.

opus-4.8.label: Opus 4.8 (Review C / Claude judgment)
opus-4.8.notes: Pinned Claude reliability/judgment pass. Routed across live Claude seats by teamclaude. NEVER the default implementer.

review-e.label: Review E (independent-family review slot)
review-e.notes: REPLACEABLE slot: Fireworks open-weight today, a local open-weight LLM later. Its value is independence (a third family), not capacity. Review-only; engages on QUOTA evidence, never an outage. Model id pinned by owner at wiring — see fireworks-usage.md. Never sees secrets/PII.

cursor-grok.label: Cursor Grok 4.6 / Composer (IDE)
cursor-grok.notes: First-party Cursor Models pool. Drain here for IDE-shaped edits before Grok Build Heavy. Not the orchestration implementer.

cursor-other-400.label: Cursor Other Models $400 (Last $)
cursor-other-400.notes: Metered $/month third-party pool. LAST resort after all native buckets. Never a default worker or a cross-family reviewer (harness, not an independent family).

local-llm-example.label: Local LLM (template — disabled)
local-llm-example.notes: TEMPLATE showing how to register a future local open-weight CLI/runtime (e.g. Ollama). Copy this entry, set enabled:true, give it a model + detect, and doctor/detect-agents/resolve-route pick it up with no prose edits. Keep review_eligible:false until an owner cross-family review lands it.

opus-5.reason: Owner policy: Opus 5 is forbidden as a default or reviewer. Pin Opus 4.8. doctor.py fails if any config or generated artifact selects opus-5.

review_order_note: Frontier fallback order. single-frontier = first LIVE seat in this order. cross-family = one pass each from two DIFFERENT families (fable-5 + opus-4.8 are both anthropic — never two Anthropic passes). resolve-route.py computes the live chain from this order + usage-status + grants.
